Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Supplier portal — language selection causes login to drop

Hi Logan,

We're trying to complete the vendor setup for PivotalWare but are hitting a reproducible failure when our team selects Italian (it) from the language picker on your supplier portal. After entering SSO details we get bounced back to the login screen with no tenant selected and the session log shows a 302 -> 200 loop.

Steps we took:
- Click supplier invite link from email (link received from Redwood)
- Choose "Italian / Italiano" from the language dropdown on the first page
- SSO redirect happens to our IdP, we sign in successfully
- Redirect back to Redwood returns to /login (no tenant param)

Observed headers in a HAR we attached show Accept-Language: it,en;q=0.9 and a cookie named _rwd_tenant is not being set on the final redirect. If we repeat the flow and leave language as English, the tenant is preserved and we proceed to the onboarding form.

This is blocking our procurement team — PO #9876 is pending until we can confirm our supplier profile. Can you advise a workaround and escalate? Attached: sso-redirect-trace.har, login-screenshot.png

Thanks,
Claudia Rossi

Claudia — quick workaround while we investigate: two low-risk options we've used before.

Option A (URL param): Append ?locale=en&tenant=redwood-pivotalware to the invite link you received (replace tenant slug with the tenant value in your invite). That forces the tenant binding and bypasses the language picker normalization. Example: https://supplier.redwood.ai/invite/ABC123?locale=en&tenant=redwood-pivotalware

Option B (browser): Open the invite link in a private/incognito window and don't interact with the language picker — the default should remain English and the SSO flow will preserve the tenant.

I tested Option A internally — it allowed the HAR flow to set _rwd_tenant cookie on the final redirect. Please confirm if that gets you past the PO hold.
